test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Both are excellent singers, but I think Kartik is best.
solution:
The correct sentence is- 'is best' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the **adjective **'*best*' is incorrectly used.
 
• As the given sentence is **comparing **the two persons we need a **comparative adjective**.
 
• **Best **is a *superlative*, i.e. it states the position of this one thing compared to all the other things under discussion. While **better **is a *comparative*, i.e. it is used to compare two things relative to one another.
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Her second book is **best **than her first one. *(**incorrect**)
 
• *Her second book is **better **than her first one. *(**correct**)
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus *option 4 *is the correct answer.

And the correct sentence is: *Both are excellent singers, but I think Kartik is **better**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand more about the **comparatives**:

 
 
• A comparative is the form of **adjective **or **adverb **used to compare two things.

 
 
• **Example:**

 
 
• *Mark listens **more attentively **these days.*
 
• *David was **smarter **than John.*
